text: The authors state that the debate model relies on agents being approximately matched in strength, since a much stronger Alice may be able to lie in ways Bob cannot refute, and note that symmetry is easy to achieve by self-play with shared weights. They also flag that the asymmetry between first and second player could produce a significant first-mover advantage or disadvantage, which would be measurable.
title: Debate relies on approximately matched debater strength; first-mover asymmetry
